title: supabase-grants-lint config
description: Configuration for supabase-grants-lint, in grants-lint.config.json or package.json#grantsLint. Every key is optional.

ruleSetting.description: "off" disables the rule; "warn" and "error" set its severity.

$schema.description: URL or path of this schema, for editor validation and hover help.

migrations.description: Where the SQL migrations are: a directory, a glob, a .sql file, or a list of these. Relative to the project directory (--dir).

schemaPaths.description: Declarative schema files (supabase/schemas). "auto" finds them as the Supabase CLI does: [db.migrations] schema_paths in supabase/config.toml, else the pg-delta declarative directory, else supabase/schemas. A list of paths and globs (relative to the project directory) replaces that; [] skips declarative schemas.

schemas.description: Schemas whose tables, views and sequences are checked.

since.description: Enforce rules only on migrations after this version. "auto" detects the opt-in migration (the last one that revokes default table privileges from anon, authenticated and service_role); "none" enforces every file; otherwise a migration version, the digits before the first "_" of a file name.

platformDefaults.description: Default privileges before the first migration. "legacy": postgres grants ALL on new tables and sequences in public to anon, authenticated and service_role (the platform before the change). "explicit": no default grants.

platformRevokeAtSince.description: When since is a version (from the config or --since), assume the platform revoked the default table and sequence grants just before the first enforced migration, as for projects opted in from the dashboard or on 2026-10-30.

autoRls.description: Engine export only (grants-lint's rules ignore it): whether new tables in public start with row level security on, as Supabase's ensure_rls event trigger makes them. "auto": while a migration-created trigger is enabled, or from a migration that defines public.rls_auto_enable() returning event_trigger until it is dropped. "on": from the start. "off": only explicit ALTER TABLE statements.

platformPublications.description: Engine export only (grants-lint's rules ignore it): publications that exist, empty, before the first migration, because the database image creates them. [] for Postgres outside Supabase.

migrationRole.description: Role that runs the migrations and creates the relations; its default privileges apply to new relations.

clientRoles.description: Roles that reach tables through the Data API with a user's token. Policies for these roles are checked.

serviceRole.description: Role server code uses; it bypasses RLS but still needs grants.

serviceOnly.description: Relations only server code uses. They are exempt from the client-role rules (GL002, GL003) and still checked by GL001.

postgresMajor.description: Postgres major version of the project. From 17, fix SQL also revokes MAINTAIN.

rules.description: Turn rules off or change their severity, keyed by rule ID.

ignore.description: Suppressed findings. Each entry needs a rule and a non-empty reason; relation and file narrow it.

relation.description: Only suppress findings on this relation, e.g. public.todos.

file.description: Only suppress findings in this migration file.

reason.description: Why the finding is suppressed. Required.
